title: John Lennon and Paul McCartney’s contracts with Northern Songs expire | 1973
content:
John Lennon and Paul McCartney’s songwriting contract with music publishers Northern Songs expired on 10 February 1973.

The end of their contract meant that the two men were able to have any new compositions published by a company of their choosing. Lennon and McCartney had been under contract with Northern Songs since 1963.
